name: galadon
description: A five-stage engineering loop for agent-built projects: spec, build, verify, ship, learn. Pluggable role, template, deploy and tool ports.

interface.shortDescription: A five-stage engineering loop for agent-built projects
interface.longDescription: Galadon initializes an agent-ready engineering workspace with one stable loop: spec, build, verify, ship, learn. Role policy, project templates, deployment adapters and tools are pluggable ports; the bundled local implementation is a reference, not the framework.
